title: Geometric stalks of finite locally constant sheaves of sets are finite
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on its small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Assume $\mathcal F$ is *finite locally constant*: there is a jointly surjective etale covering $\{u_i:U_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ and, for each $i$, a finite set $S_i$ and an isomorphism of sheaves $\mathcal F|_{U_i}\cong\underline{S_i}$ on $(U_i)_{\Et}$, where $\mathcal F|_{U_i}$ is the restriction $V\mapsto\mathcal F(V)$ for $V\to U_i$ etale, viewed over $Y$ through $u_i$, and $\underline{S_i}$ is the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value $S_i$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then for every geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point], the geometric stalk $\mathcal F_{\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is a finite set. This includes the case $S_i=\varnothing$.

The finite-stalk consequence is agent-formulated.

split_report.summary: Split following Stacks 03RU (sets), 03PR, 03Q1 (3) and its proof, 03PT (2). Steps: lift the geometric point to a member U_i of the covering (leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-cover-geometric-point-lift); the stalk of F|_{U_i} at the lift maps onto F_ybar (the reindexing of neighbourhoods in the proof of 03Q1 (3), written out with W x_Y U_i; only surjectivity is needed and proved); the given isomorphism with the constant sheaf is a bijection on stalks; the stalk of the constant sheaf of sets with value S_i is the image of S_i (stalk of the constant presheaf, every neighbourhood maps to (U_i, ubar), plus sheafification preserves stalks, leaf lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheafification-geometric-stalk); conclusion |F_ybar| <= |S_i|. No new node: every non-definition node cited is a Mathlib leaf. The abelian lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-geometric-stalk and lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction were not used (abelian only); lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-stalk-germ would need a sets version of the restriction/inverse-image identification, so the 03Q1 reindexing was written directly. Statement kept; added the citation [def-weil-geometric-point] and its stmt_dep. Lean: in slopmaster2, Scheme.IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheafOfTypes (WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/HenselianFiniteEtale.lean 83-87) is 'locally constant (values unrestricted) and IsFiniteSheaf', and IsFiniteSheaf (WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/Defs.lean 192-195) is the class whose field isFinitelyGenerated_sheafFiber assumes finite stalks; finiteness of the stalks is built into the Lean definition, so no declaration states this node (a structure field is not a proof of it); not attached.

lean.statement: theorem finite_stalk_of_finite_locally_constant_sets {Y : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (hF : ∃ 𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.etalePrecoverage Y, ∀ i, ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧ Nonempty ((F.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅ (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (Type (u + 1))).obj S)) : ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y), Finite ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F)
